Return value
E2E_PCheckStatusType
Profile-independent status of the reception on one single Data in
one cycle.
Description
The function maps the check status of Profile 4 to a generic check status, which can be used by
E2E state machine check function. The E2E Profile 4 delivers a more fine-granular status, but
this is not relevant for the E2E state machine.
Available via
E2E.h
